rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: 2023 - Construction of a new environmental education classroom to replace a smaller existing building and provide a bathroom. The project also includes installation of supporting facilities such as water, power, and septic lines, elevated boardwalks across small sections of wetland or buffer to improve existing access routes, and a floating dock on the pond for improved access. 2,056 square feet of wetland fill is proposed as part of the classroom expansion while utilizing the existing footprint of the current structure.
